game_title: Max Finder Derby – Owl Roost Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mystic Forest – Owl Roost, a night-time owl roost: the wood elf archer must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Max Finder Derby: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants.
theme: Mystic Forest – Owl Roost: a night-time owl roost
core_gameplay_loop: In Owl Roost, repeat each round: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants. Each round, bog toads strike the spirit shrine, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the best value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the spirit shrine from bog toads in Owl Roost: keep the best meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 30-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: best drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 30-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Max Finder Derby
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

region.name: Mystic Forest

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how best changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bog toads in Owl Roost.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 30 seconds while best > 0.
